summary: Tested the Supabase-backed F&B POS end to end (backend API + UI). I found and fixed one critical backend bug: GET /api/transactions and GET /api/shifts returned 500, and waiter-shift lists failed too. Cause: rows whose userId was set to NULL by the FK rule ON DELETE SET NULL after TEST_ users were deleted. After that fix, these all passed: login and PIN error; all 15 admin pages; POS order types and Ojol prices; saving and voiding an open bill; the stock trigger (INV-001 -18, INV-010 -1, applied once); kasir opening a shift, Kas Masuk, blind close with selisih; kasir reduce-PIN prompt; waiter flows; table dialog and layout cancel; fullscreen. I also fixed a horizontal overflow on /pos at 800px portrait.

critical.issue: 500 ValidationError 'userId Input should be a valid string' because Supabase FK 'on delete set null' nulls userId when a user is deleted (TRX-20261016-0014/15/18/19/20, SHIFT-20261016-002/004/005, WSHIFT-002/003, KAS-0001..0004). FIXED by T1: userId made Optional[str] in Transaction/Purchase/Expense/OpenBill (core.py), Shift/CashMovement (shifts.py), WaiterShift (targets.py).

minor.issue: Each query to Supabase takes about 0.8s (simple GET /api/auth/users = 0.8s). Pages that run many sequential queries (e.g. /api/shifts runs summarize() for each open shift; create_transaction runs about 15 sequential queries) feel slow. Voiding a bill took more than 2.5s. Consider batching, or running SQL in a single connection/transaction.

Not atomic. The transaction insert, open-bill delete, table mark_paid and order_logs writes are separate statements with no DB transaction. A failure halfway leaves inconsistent state (e.g. a transaction saved while its bill is still open).
CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True. Auth uses a Bearer token stored in localStorage, not httpOnly cookies.

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 959 > 800): the cart panel was cut off. FIXED by T1: grid columns changed to minmax(0,1fr) in POS.jsx line 134.
Shows 'Belum ada shift aktif.' (target-empty) for about 2-3s while /targets/progress is still loading, then shows the real progress. Needs a loading state.

issues: Cart column is only 300px. Item names are truncated to 1-2 characters ('K...', 'C...') and the customer/waiter selects are clipped ('Pelanggan um', 'Tanpa pelayai'). Consider stacking the cart below the product grid, or a narrower product grid, in portrait tablet.
Text still says 'MongoDB' after the Supabase migration.

The customer's real DB has many leftover TEST_ records visible to users: TEST_T1*/TEST_UI* products, TEST_T1/TESTCAT categories, TEST_AREA/TEST_ZONE table areas, and user TEST_UIUser (USR-007) on the login screen. Clean these up.

action_items: Review T1 fix: userId Optional in models. Also consider whether other FK 'set null' columns (customerId, tableId, waiterId, shiftId) can break any required model fields.
Improve POS portrait-tablet (800px) cart layout: names are truncated.
Add a loading state on Targets so 'Belum ada shift aktif' is not shown while loading.
Reduce sequential Supabase round trips (about 0.8s each) and wrap create_transaction in a DB transaction.
Update the Schema page text that still says MongoDB.
Clean up the records created by T1 (listed in seed_data_creation), plus older TEST_ leftovers.
critical_code_review_comments: pgdb.Collection has no multi-statement transaction support, so every server write flow is non-atomic.
server.py is 831 lines and should be split into routers.
consume_stock is now only a pre-check; the DB trigger does the actual decrement (verified to run once). The pre-check is not atomic with the trigger, but the stock>=0 CHECK constraint protects it.
core.py still imports motor/pymongo (ReturnDocument), which is unused now that the DB is Postgres.

success_rate.backend: 100% after fix (23/23 read-only tests; 3 failed before: 2 real 500s plus 1 test param issue)

context_for_next_testing_agent: DB is the customer's real Supabase (DATABASE_URL in backend/.env); keep writes minimal and TEST_-prefixed. Existing tests in /app/backend/tests (test_pos_*.py, test_t1_*.py) WRITE data and delete users, which is what caused the null userId rows. Do NOT run them against Supabase. Use test_supabase_readonly.py instead. Supabase latency is about 0.8s per query, so use 3-5s waits in UI tests. The waiter USR-WAITER already had open shift WSHIFT-007, so start-waiter-shift-button was not shown (not tested). Open bills BILL-077 (Dine In, no table) and BILL-064 (Meja 3) are real data.
rca of the issue: Deleting TEST users (likely from earlier test runs) triggered FK 'references users(id) on delete set null'. This set userId=NULL on their transactions/shifts/cash_movements/waiter_shifts. The Pydantic models declared userId: str, so from_mongo() raised a ValidationError for any list containing those rows, which returned 500. Mitigation applied: userId Optional[str]=None. Alternative: use ON DELETE RESTRICT, or soft-delete users.
